links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy on MedQA problems in static format versus sequential agent format
links.effect: Diagnostic accuracies can drop to below a tenth of the original accuracy when MedQA problems are posed in the sequential decision-making format.
links.quote: We find that solving MedQA problems in the sequential decision-making format of AgentClinic is considerably more challenging, resulting in diagnostic accuracies that can drop to below a tenth of the original accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Persistent notebook tool for experiential learning across cases
Adaptive retrieval and reflection cycles to improve agent performance

screen.reason: AgentClinic benchmarks autonomous clinical AI agents in a simulated interactive environment comparing agent architectures/tools rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
